description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the ReportGeneratorService in the OrangeHRM project. It defines various test methods to verify the behavior of report generation and header configuration functionalities within the core service layer, utilizing mock objects and fixture data.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ReportGeneratorService functionalities such as report type verification, header configuration, and report data normalization in the OrangeHRM core service layer.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creates an instance of ReportGeneratorService, and populates the database with fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testIsPimReport
methods.description: Tests the isPimReport method to verify it correctly identifies PIM reports based on report ID.

methods.name: testGetHeaderDefinitionByReportId
methods.description: Tests the retrieval and structure of report header definitions for a given report ID, including internationalization.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedReportData
methods.description: Verifies the normalized report data fetched for a specific report ID and checks the total record count.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedReportDataForPastEmployees
methods.description: Checks the report data normalization for historical employee reports, ensuring correct data is returned with correct count.
